purpose: Tracks cloud-credit spend for cloud sessions started from this repo. The user set a cap; every cloud run is priced per model from its own transcripts with scripts/claude-cost-report.mjs.
stopRule: Do not start a phase whose estimate exceeds (cap - spent). Stop and report at 90% of the cap.
rates: USD per million tokens, see RATES in scripts/claude-cost-report.mjs (Fable 5.1 10/50, Opus 5.5 4/20, Sonnet 5.5 2/10, Haiku 4.5 1/5; cache read 0.25/0.20/0.20/0.10; cache write 1.25x input for 5-minute TTL, 2x for 1-hour)
